The master is so strange. He can go out to play every day and has many companions, 
yet he always hides away, whimpering or sitting alone in a daze.
One-track mind went to ask his best friend—a dog named Iron Pot.
Iron Pot told him that humans eat their food and throw away the bones. Without bones to lick, of course, they're unhappy.
One-track mind took this to heart. The next day, he traveled far and wide, carefully selecting until he found the most delicious bone. He carried the Meaty Bone all the way home, drooling nonstop, his stomach growling with hunger, yet he refused to take a single bite.
Finally home, he placed the bone by his master's bedside, hoping that licking the Meaty Bone would stop his master's tears from flowing.
